_comment: hard_false_positives_strict is 0 and must stay 0: a row the manifest says must not act in strict mode, that acted, is a broken Shabbat. Any number above zero blocks the release.
hint_recall_min is a quality bar, not a safety one: a missed hint is cheap.
decider_failure_rate_max bounds timeouts and malformed answers; every one of those is a NO_DECISION, which never acts.
